svg.text: BZN-MB rev A: board block diagram
Servo power flows along the top band, logic and sensing along the bottom band. Pins, addresses and channels match software/firmware/stm32f411 (main.h, joint_table.h).
Rails: +5V_LOGIC → U1 5 V pin through a Schottky (USB back-feed); +3V3 from U1 → U2–U7, U14–U17; +5VA → U8–U13. Sheet 2 has the full power tree.
BZN-01 Bazan humanoid: mainboard BZN-MB rev A
